privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AAIGC ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our website and services.
privacy.dataCollectDesc: We collect only the information you voluntarily provide:
dataCollectItems: Account information: email address, display name, and avatar (when you register or log in via Google/GitHub OAuth)
Usage data: page views and tool usage counts for analytics purposes (anonymized)
Communication data: email address when you contact us
dataUseItems: Authenticating your identity via OAuth providers (Google, GitHub)
Improving our services through anonymized usage analytics
privacy.dataStorageDesc: Your data is stored on secure cloud servers. We take reasonable measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest.
privacy.dataRetentionDesc: We retain your account data until you delete your account. After deletion, your data will be fully removed.
privacy.thirdPartyDesc: We use the following third-party services:
privacy.cookiesDesc: We use a functional cookie to remember your language preference. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics cookies. Our usage analytics are anonymized and do not involve cookies.
privacy.rightsDesc: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
rightsItems: Delete your data (right to be forgotten)
privacy.contactDesc: For questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
privacy.gdprDesc: If you are in the European Economic Area, you have additional rights under GDPR. Our legal basis for processing your data is your consent (when you register) and legitimate interest (for analytics).
privacy.ccpaDesc: California residents have the right to request disclosure of collected data, request deletion, and opt out of data sales. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.pipDesc: If you are in China, your personal data is processed in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL). Your data is stored in Singapore.
